intensity.effort: Comfortably hard and controlled (about 6-7 of 10): short phrases only; you could hold it much longer than the repetition

instructions: Warm up 10 minutes easy
3 × 5 min — Comfortably hard and controlled (about 6-7 of 10): short phrases only; you could hold it much longer than the repetition; 2 min easy jog or walk between
Cool down 5 minutes easy
First exposure: let effort set the pace and note the pace you observe; there is no pace target
Hold form and effort; if effort climbs above the cue, end the hard part early — an easy finish is fine
Record repetitions completed, effort and next-day function
